items.source: Typically XhrTransport implementations are also implementations of this contract.
items.translation: 通常，XhrTransport 实现也是该契约的实现。

items.source: Note that as of 4.2 this method accepts a headers parameter.
items.translation: 注意，自 4.2 版本起，此方法接受一个 `headers` 参数。

items.source: Perform an HTTP request to the SockJS "Info" URL.
items.translation: 向 SockJS“信息”URL 发送 HTTP 请求。

items.source: infoUrl - the URL to obtain SockJS server information from
items.translation: infoUrl - 用于获取 SockJS 服务器信息的 URL

items.source: headers - the headers to use for the request
